page.title: Shoreline Connect
page.description: A website for Shoreline Community Services: get help, volunteer, donate, and track your impact.

settings.title: Shoreline Connect
settings.lead: Shoreline Community Services helps unsheltered neighbors in San Diego's Central Beach Area find housing, health care, work and support. We built them a site where people can get help, sign up to volunteer, and log the hours they give.

settings.body: Shoreline runs on volunteers, but signing up, finding the right role and keeping track of hours happened on paper and by phone. People who needed help had to dig for the help line and the Compass Station's hours. We wanted one place where a neighbor can find help in two clicks and a volunteer can sign up, choose how to help and see their impact.

settings.title: Our partner: Shoreline Community Services
settings.body: For ten years Shoreline has run The Compass Station, a drop-in resource center at 1004 Chalcedony St, plus street outreach, a medical respite hotel program and the Community Care Crew, a paid transitional jobs program.
